correctness.rationale: Derive from the Nijenhuis identity N(x)N(y)=N(N(x)y+xN(y)-N(xy)): let N(1)=a+u, N(v)=f(v)+T(v), v²=0. Evaluating v,v scalar part gives f(v)²=2f(v)² => f(v)=0 in EVERY characteristic. Evaluating (1,1) gives Tu=au; remaining basis pairs verify sufficiency. Matrix block ranks are r or r+1 depending on scalar a and whether u lies in image T. Counting rank-r maps with given kernel/image and u fixed uses standard q-Gaussian coefficients and bijective quotient maps, recovering displayed M,A,B,F terms. Independent direct all-linear-map Nijenhuis evaluation (not only Tu=au check) and rank histograms gave n=1 q=2: (1,3,2), n=1 q=3: (1,6,8), n=2 q=2: (1,16,27,12), n=2 q=3: (1,58,208,192), n=3 q=2: (1,78,623,882,336). Algebraic proof covers all fields; finite experiments do not establish it alone.
